tasks.short: Take quote requests and orders from dealers or customers.

steps.what: Take quote requests or orders from dealers or customers.
Extract items and prices from a written order.

loop.output: Item, quantity, price and customer, blank where the page is unclear
loop.check: Representative checks each line against the page
loop.stop: One pass; an unclear line is not entered
loop.why_not_simpler: Written orders are not one form

steps.what: Check lines against the item master and the price list.
Fix a line the check rejects, with the dealer if needed.

tasks.design: Spoken requests stay with the representative. A written order is read for item, quantity, price and customer, then checked against the item master and the price list. A failed line stops for the representative. Only accepted lines are entered. Native order entry is tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: PDF and mailed orders were retyped into the finance system, and spoken orders were written up afterwards.
tasks.enabler_now: A check against the item master can stop a bad line. A spoken order and a failed line still need the representative.
tasks.still_hard: Dealer shorthand, prices that do not match the list, and orders for items not in the master.
tasks.human_edge: The representative knows when a dealer means a substitute and when they do not.

ambition.what: The representative decides, the same day, whether an order's lines are clean enough to enter.

tasks.altitude: Taking the request stays on the week. The representative can refuse to enter a line the price list rejected.

reach.task: Take a booking request and enter it only when the details match
reach.learn: How they stop an entry that does not match the published price

evidence.claim: An order tool can key items, prices and the customer from a forwarded order into the finance system, and staff still check.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from a request or a written order to an entered sales order. Installation scheduling is out of scope.

Structured fields are item code, quantity, unit price and customer account. The dealer or customer produces the order. The item master produces the allowed price. Fallback: a failed check is not overridden by the entry step.
Test native {ERP} order entry before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers item and price exceptions.
unknowns: What share of orders arrives as a portal form, a PDF, or a phone call.
Whether dealers have contract prices below the list.
research_questions: What share of written orders fails the item or price check?

approvals.approved_version: lines the representative accepted after the price check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most orders are spoken or fail the price check, so entry stays manual. High: clean written orders enter after a short check, and spoken orders are unchanged. A rejected line is not forced in.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and review solar installation drawings and lists.

steps.what: Prepare the equipment list for the solar installation.
Draw the installation layout on the design drawings.
Review drawings and specifications against the site measurements.
Issue the checked drawing and list to the installer.

tasks.design: The equipment list comes from the chosen system. The representative still draws the layout and reviews it against the site measurements and the clearances. Only that checked pack is issued to the installer. Native list configuration is tested before any drawing tool is customised.
tasks.previous_blocker: Lists were copied from the quote, and drawings were marked up without a tie back to the measurements.
tasks.enabler_now: The list can follow the system choice. The drawing and the clearance check are the representative's.
tasks.still_hard: Roofs that do not match the measurements, and specifications the list does not know.
tasks.human_edge: The representative can see that a neat drawing will not fit the roof they measured.
tasks.altitude: Drawing time stays on the week. The representative can refuse to issue a pack that fails the measurement check.

reach.task: Review a plan against what was seen on site
reach.learn: Which mismatch is enough to hold the paper back

evidence.claim: A system choice can produce an equipment list. The layout drawing and the check against the site stay with a person.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from a chosen system and site measurements to an issued drawing and list. Structural engineering sign-off is out of scope.
Structured fields are component codes, quantities and the measurements already stored. The system choice produces the codes. Fallback: a roof with no measurements is not issued.
Test native bill-of-material configuration before custom drawing code.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers component codes.
unknowns: Whether installers require a drawing from this representative or from a designer.
research_questions: What share of layouts is a standard roof rather than a one-off?

incremental.description: Update component codes on the equipment list

approvals.approved_version: drawing and list the representative reviewed against the measurements

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every roof is a one-off, so the list saves little and the drawing is unchanged. High: the list is generated and the drawing and the review stay. The drawing is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create a custom energy package for the customer.

steps.what: Hear which loads the customer wants the package to cover.
Assemble panel, storage, heat and charging options from catalogue rules.
Create customized energy management packages for the customer.
Price that package from the tariff and the product list.
Present the package and record what the customer accepts.

tasks.design: Catalogue rules propose panels, storage, heat and charging from the loads the customer named. The representative changes the package where the household does not fit the rule, the {ERP} prices that version, and the representative presents it. Native catalogue configuration is tested before custom code. The representative, not an unattended process, chooses the package.
tasks.previous_blocker: Packages were assembled from separate brochures and priced in a sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Past projects can suggest a package shape. This customer's use still changes it.
tasks.still_hard: Households whose use is nothing like the past projects, and heat or charging loads nobody measured.
tasks.human_edge: The representative hears which part of the package the customer will not accept.

ambition.what: A household can be offered one package that covers solar, storage, heat and charging, priced under the current tariff, instead of four separate quotes.

tasks.altitude: Package conversations stay on the week. The representative can drop a component the rule suggested.

reach.task: Bundle cover into one offer the customer can accept or cut
reach.learn: How they show what each part costs before the customer says yes

evidence.claim: Installer software can plan a solar, storage, heat and charging package from past projects. A person still chooses.
The package price has to follow the feed-in rule that applies after net metering ends on 1 January 2027.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from the loads the customer wants covered to a package they have accepted or refused in the meeting. Installation is out of scope.

Structured fields are load types, component codes and tariff code. The customer names the loads. The catalogue produces allowed combinations. Fallback: an unmeasured load is left out of the package rather than assumed.
Test native catalogue bundles before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers allowed combinations.
unknowns: Whether heat and charging are in this business's catalogue.
Whether past projects are clean enough to use as examples.
research_questions: What share of customers wants more than panels?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: loads are unmeasured, so the catalogue proposal is useless and the conversation is the whole task. High: a standard bundle is close and the representative only adjusts and presents it. The adjustment is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop a marketing plan for a sales territory.

steps.what: Pull territory wins, losses and the pipeline.
Summarise incentive and competitor changes in the territory.

loop.input: The trade notes the representative already saved, with their links
loop.output: A short note of incentive and competitor changes, each with a link
loop.check: Representative opens each link before using the point
loop.stop: One pass; a point with no link is dropped
loop.why_not_simpler: Trade notes are prose, and an unlinked claim is not a plan input

steps.what: Develop marketing and strategic plans for sales territories.

tasks.design: The {CRM} shows wins, losses and pipeline for the territory. A note of incentive and competitor changes keeps only points the representative can open. The representative writes the plan, the sales manager approves it, and that version is filed. Native reports are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan was a slide rebuilt from exports and unread newsletters.
tasks.enabler_now: A pipeline report is configuration. The choice of where to spend the quarter is not.
tasks.still_hard: Territories whose pipeline is wrong, and competitor claims with no source.
tasks.human_edge: The representative knows which loss was price and which was a roof the business should not have chased.

ambition.what: The representative decides each quarter which part of the territory to work, from a pipeline that is already counted.

tasks.altitude: Writing the plan stays on the week. The representative can leave a competitor claim out when the link does not support it.

reach.task: Set where the office will spend its effort this quarter
reach.learn: Which pipeline facts they treat as real enough to plan on

evidence.claim: A customer-system report can show pipeline and results. A model can summarise notes the user already holds, with links. The plan itself stays with a person.
Works-council consent is required before activity tracking that observes sellers. This design uses opportunity totals, not call analytics.

assumptions: Focal role is the solar sales representative. Boundary: from territory history to a filed plan the sales manager has approved. Running the campaigns is out of scope.
Structured fields are territory, stage, value and close result. The opportunity record produces them. Fallback: a figure the report cannot tie to opportunities is not used.
Test native {CRM} pipeline reports before custom code. Do not turn on seller monitoring.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers territory definitions. Manager time is already in the approval step.
unknowns: Whether territories are defined in the customer system.
Who must approve a plan before it is used.
research_questions: How often does the pipeline disagree with what the representative believes closed?

incremental.description: Maintain territory definitions on the report

approvals.approved_version: plan version the sales manager approved

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the pipeline is not trusted, so the plan is still written from memory and the summary is unused. High: the figures are usable and only the writing and the approval remain. The plan is not generated for the representative.

role.altitude: The week is still site visits, demonstrations and customer conversations. Quotes and yield figures are calculated before the meeting. The representative can refuse to send a price or a saving the tariff rule did not produce.
reach: Insurance sales agents: which funding question needs a licensed credit conversation
Real estate sales agents: how a visit is written down before a price is discussed
skills_to_grow: Checking a yield figure against shading the model missed
Keeping consumer calls inside the opt-in list
Reading a drawing against a measurement
role.ambitious_version: Every quote starts from a tariff rule the representative will sign, and no consumer is called without an opt-in.
